payload.title: Build a Minimal Transformer Encoder-Decoder for English-to-Spanish Translation
payload.instruction_text: Implement a compact but fully functional encoder-decoder Transformer model in Keras for English-to-Spanish translation. Your model must include: (1) an encoder with multi-head self-attention, layer normalization, and feed-forward layers; (2) a decoder with masked multi-head self-attention, encoder-decoder cross-attention, layer normalization, and feed-forward layers; (3) proper causal masking for decoder self-attention; and (4) integration with Keras TextVectorization layers for both source and target languages. Train the model for exactly 3 epochs on the provided small-scale parallel corpus (English/Spanish sentence pairs). The final submission must be a callable Keras Model object named `transformer_model` that accepts `(encoder_inputs, decoder_inputs)` and outputs logits over the Spanish vocabulary.
payload.starter_code:
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers, models

def get_angles(pos, i, d_model):
    angle_rates = 1 / tf.pow(10000, (2 * (i // 2)) / tf.cast(d_model, tf.float32))
    return pos * angle_rates

def positional_encoding(position, d_model):
    angle_rads = get_angles(
        pos=tf.range(position)[:, tf.newaxis],
        i=tf.range(d_model)[tf.newaxis, :],
        d_model=d_model
    )
    angle_rads = tf.where(tf.math.mod(tf.range(d_model), 2) == 0,
                          tf.math.sin(angle_rads),
                          tf.math.cos(angle_rads))
    pos_encoding = tf.cast(angle_rads[tf.newaxis, ...], tf.float32)
    return pos_encoding

constraints: Use exactly one encoder block and one decoder block (no stacking).
Apply causal (upper-triangular) attention mask only to decoder self-attention; use no mask for encoder self-attention or cross-attention.
Do not use prebuilt transformer layers (e.g., keras_nlp.layers.TransformerEncoder); implement attention and layer logic explicitly using core Keras layers.
The model must be built entirely within the provided starter code scaffold — no external functions or classes beyond those imported or defined.
Output logits must have shape (None, None, VOCAB_SIZE_TGT) and be unnormalized (no softmax).
